1.web: I will give you thanks with my whole heart. Before the gods, I will sing praises to you.
1.asv: I will give thee thanks with my whole heart: Before the gods will I sing praises unto thee.

2.web: I will bow down toward your holy temple, and give thanks to your Name for your loving kindness and for your truth; for you have exalted your Name and your Word above all.
2.asv: I will worship toward thy holy temple, And give thanks unto thy name for thy lovingkindness and for thy truth: For thou hast magnified thy word above all thy name.

3.web: In the day that I called, you answered me. You encouraged me with strength in my soul.
3.asv: In the day that I called thou answeredst me, Thou didst encourage me with strength in my soul.

4.web: All the kings of the earth will give you thanks, Yahweh, for they have heard the words of your mouth.
4.asv: All the kings of the earth shall give thee thanks, O Jehovah, For they have heard the words of thy mouth.

5.web: Yes, they will sing of the ways of Yahweh; for great is Yahweh’s glory.
5.asv: Yea, they shall sing of the ways of Jehovah; For great is the glory of Jehovah.

6.web: For though Yahweh is high, yet he looks after the lowly; but the proud, he knows from afar.
6.asv: For though Jehovah is high, yet hath he respect unto the lowly; But the haughty he knoweth from afar.

7.web: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, you will revive me. You will stretch out your hand against the wrath of my enemies. Your right hand will save me.
7.asv: Though I walk in the midst of trouble, thou wilt revive me; Thou wilt stretch forth thy hand against the wrath of mine enemies, And thy right hand will save me.

8.web: Yahweh will fulfill that which concerns me; your loving kindness, Yahweh, endures forever. Don’t forsake the works of your own hands.
8.asv: Jehovah will perfect that which concerneth me: Thy lovingkindness, O Jehovah, endureth for ever; Forsake not the works of thine own hands.
